ICARUS-LEO config builder

Generates config_*.py files for the ICARUS-LEO simulator, an extension of the Icarus framework. Use a JSON array like [1e-6, 5e-6] in any numeric or text field to sweep that parameter; multiple arrays produce nested loops.

Experiment metadata

Top-level settings of the generated config file. The filename is used both for the file you download and inside the generated docstring as part of the suggested icarus run command.

DATA_COLLECTORS

Select at least one. SESSION_LOG is required if you want to generate the interactive HTML viewer.

topology

Pick a preset constellation or a custom Walker-Delta. Dynamic variants (LEO_DYN_*) precompute handover snapshots.

Custom Walker constellation

Common parameters — emitted only when different from defaults

Receiver placement — D2D model selection

Dynamic / handover

TLE / SGP4 propagation

workload

Content request workload. STATIONARY_CHUNKED is the chunk-level variant (one Data packet per chunk). n_chunks only applies to that workload.

cache placement / policy

Cache placement decides which network nodes hold caches and their sizes. Cache policy decides how each individual cache evicts entries (LRU, FIFO, LFU, …).

strategy

Forwarding / caching strategy. Lossy variants apply the loss model on every hop; Retry variants add retransmission of lost chunks. The latency of every hop always includes the propagation delay and the transmission time (packet size in bits divided by the link rate set in the Topology tab); queueing is not modelled. Sub-fields below adapt to the chosen strategy.

Retry parameters

PROB_CACHE parameters

loss_model G-E v20: per-link-type

Packet loss model. Pick NONE for a noiseless simulation (the loss_model key is omitted from the strategy dict). G-E v20 supports per-link-type BERs.

Bernoulli i.i.d.

Gilbert-Elliott (two-state Markov)

Scalar BER (default fallback)

Used for any link type that does not have an explicit per-link-type BER below.

Per-link-type BER (leave blank to use scalar defaults)

Available since v20. Resolution: specific > family (e.g. ber_*_isl covers both intra and inter) > scalar default. user_radio falls back to gsl (same slant range) when not set.

Composite (per-link-type sub-models)

Routes each loss decision to a different sub-model based on the link type. Use this when different physical links need different loss models, e.g. a recorded trace on the radio link plus Bernoulli on satellite links plus no loss on cabled links. Each section below configures one link type; link types left unconfigured have no loss.

Load existing config file preview

Load a previously-generated .py config to pre-populate the form. Only configs generated by this builder are supported (single experiments and sweeps, including multi-axis sweeps). After loading, you can edit any field and re-download the modified config from the Output tab.

config_my_experiment.py live preview

The configuration is regenerated automatically whenever you change any field or switch tabs. Click Download .py to save the file, or select the text below and copy it (Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C).

The file will be saved in the Downloads folder.
If you have the simulator engine, run:
icarus run -r results.pickle <file>.py
and generate the interactive viewer with:
python3 tools/generate_log_viewer.py results.pickle -o viewer.html --n-viewable 1000
Otherwise, see the ICARUS-LEO repository on GitHub for how to have it run.
